lines.zh: 俗話說什麼：「你誤診了什麼，就會錯誤地治療。」

lines.en: I have experiences now and then that I don't ever bring to you,
lines.zh: 我偶爾會有一些經歷，是我從來沒有跟你們提過的，

lines.en: but I get off the airplane here in Redding, and somebody's just standing there just cursing me.
lines.zh: 我會在這裡（雷丁市）下飛機，就有個人站在那裡咒罵我。

lines.en: Christian curses, of course. Cursing me.
lines.zh: 當然是基督徒式的咒罵。咒罵我。

lines.en: Why? Well, probably they believed something they saw on YouTube,
lines.zh: 為什麼？嗯，可能他們相信了在 YouTube 上看到的東西，

lines.en: or they believed a bad report from somebody.
lines.zh: 或是聽信了某人的負面報告。

lines.en: There's never been dialogue.
lines.zh: 雙方之間從來沒有過對話。

lines.en: Is their conviction correct? It probably is.
lines.zh: 他們的信念正確嗎？可能正確。

lines.en: It's just their information is wrong.
lines.zh: 只是他們的資訊錯了。

lines.en: Does that make sense?
lines.zh: 這樣講你們能理解嗎？

lines.en: I look at them and I see they have a conviction for the Lord.
lines.zh: 我看著他們，我看到他們對主有著堅定的信念。

lines.en: They are making what they think is a righteous stand, but somebody fed them a lie that they believed.
lines.zh: 他們正在採取他們自認為公義的立場，但有人餵給他們一個謊言，而他們相信了。

lines.en: Wow, or they just don't like me, could be that too.
lines.zh: 哇，或者他們就是不喜歡我，也有可能是這樣。

lines.en: I don't know, can't be that.
lines.zh: 我不知道，不可能是那樣。

lines.en: Never mind. Yeah, impossible. Impossible.
lines.zh: 算了。對，不可能。不可能。

lines.en: So you get the point.
lines.zh: 所以你們懂我的意思。

lines.en: The point is that to be a prophetically discerning people, we have to be able to recognize the difference between the true prophetic anointing and the counterfeit,
lines.zh: 重點是，要成為一個具有先知性辨別力的子民，我們必須能夠認出真實的先知性恩膏和仿冒品之間的差別，

lines.en: which is suspicious, it's agenda-driven, and it moves in the spirit of offense.
lines.zh: 這仿冒品充滿猜疑，它是受議程驅使的，並且在冒犯之靈裡運行。

lines.en: One of the biggest challenges in life is to not pick up the offenses of the people you love and serve.
lines.zh: 人生中最大的挑戰之一，就是不要承接你所愛和服事之人的冒犯。

lines.en: It's really hard.
lines.zh: 這真的很難。

lines.en: If you give yourself to the poor, it's very hard to not be offended at the rich.
lines.zh: 如果你獻身服事窮人，你就很難不對富人感到冒犯。

lines.en: If you have been called to serve the wealthy, it's very hard to serve them well without being offended at those who don't work.
lines.zh: 如果你蒙召服事富人，你就很難在好好服事他們的同時，不對那些不工作的人感到冒犯。

lines.en: If you minister to college students, it's very difficult for you to minister to them without being offended at conservative political groups.
lines.zh: 如果你服事大學生，你就很難在服事他們的同時，不對保守派政治團體感到冒犯。

lines.en: If you minister to the old, it's very hard for you to do that well without being offended at the young.
lines.zh: 如果你服事年長者，你就很難在好好服事他們的同時，不對年輕人感到冒犯。

lines.en: The list goes on and on and on.
lines.zh: 這個清單可以一直列下去。

lines.en: If you minister to the Native Americans, First Nations people, it's very hard to do that well without picking up an offense towards those who have obviously mistreated them.
lines.zh: 如果你服事美洲原住民、第一民族的人，你就很難在好好服事他們的同時，不對那些明顯虧待過他們的人產生冒犯。

lines.en: The point is, your effectiveness and my effectiveness is in some way restrained and restricted by how well can we serve people and love them well,
lines.zh: 重點是，你我的效能在某種程度上會受到限制和約束，取決於我們能在多大程度上好好服事並愛人，

lines.en: and bring the word of the Lord for this moment for their benefit, not ours, not for our agenda, not for our identity, for their benefit entirely, without picking up any offense that they may have.
lines.zh: 並在這個時刻為著他們的益處帶出神的話語，不是為了我們，不是為了我們的議程，也不是為了我們的身分認同，完全是為了他們的益處，而不沾染任何他們可能帶有的冒犯。

lines.en: And the depth at which we get to go in the anointing to impact the course of history and affect culture is in many ways determined by how well we can navigate this thing without being offended.
lines.zh: 我們在恩膏中能進入的深度，以至於能影響歷史進程和影響文化，在許多方面取決於我們能在多大程度上妥善駕馭這件事而不被冒犯。

lessons.title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
lessons.titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
lessons.summaryZh: 我們是先知的後裔，承受了傳遞神靈與神話語的產業，因此我們口中當宣告神的話語。
lessons.ref: 以賽亞書 59; 使徒行傳 3

lines.en: That's the truth.
lines.zh: 那是真理。

lines.en: Isaiah 59, we got three more verses, so hold tight here.
lines.zh: 以賽亞書59章，我們還有三節經文，所以請大家堅持一下。

lines.en: Isaiah 59, we'll do the next two real quick, so get your gospel track shoes on and let's fly.
lines.zh: 以賽亞書59章，我們會很快地看接下來的兩節，所以穿上你們的『福音田徑鞋』，我們要起飛了。

lines.en: Isaiah 60 is, if you've been here a while, you know that it's one of my most favorite chapters because it changed my life.
lines.zh: 以賽亞書60章，如果你在這裡待過一段時間，你會知道那是我最喜歡的篇章之一，因為它改變了我的生命。

lines.en: "Arise, shine, your light has come," that whole passage I believe with all of my heart is a prophetic word for the church right now.
lines.zh: 「興起，發光！因為你的光已經來到」，我全心相信整段經文是現在給教會的先知性話語。

lines.en: But preceding that, the last verse of chapter 59 sets the stage.
lines.zh: 但在那之前，59章的最後一節奠定了基礎。

lines.en: Look at verse 21 of Isaiah 59.
lines.zh: 看看以賽亞書59章21節。

lines.en: "As for me," says the Lord, "this is my covenant with them:
lines.zh: 「至於我」，耶和華說，「與他們所立的約乃是這樣：

lines.en: My Spirit who is upon you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart from your mouth,
lines.zh: 我加給你的靈，傳給你的話，必不離你的口，

lines.en: nor from the mouth of your descendants, nor from the mouth of your descendants' descendants," says the Lord, "from this time and forever."
lines.zh: 也不離你後裔與你後裔之後裔的口」，這是耶和華說的，「從今直到永遠。」

lines.en: Please notice again the correlation between the Spirit of God coming upon people and the word of the Lord being in their mouth.
lines.zh: 請再次注意神的靈降臨在人身上，與神的話語在他們口中，兩者之間的關聯。

lines.en: The evidence that the Spirit of God is resting upon us as a people, as a tribe, as a family, must be...
lines.zh: 神的靈停留在我們這群人、這個部落、這個家庭身上的證據，一定是...

lines.en: You know how much I love the healing, the miracles, the deliverance, all those things.
lines.zh: 你們知道我有多喜歡醫治、神蹟、釋放，以及這一切的事。

lines.en: ...it must be that from our mouth comes the word of the Lord.
lines.zh: ...那證據一定就是，從我們口中會說出神的話語。

lines.en: Jesus set a standard when he said, "I only say what I hear my Father say."
lines.zh: 耶穌設立了一個標準，當祂說：「我只說我聽見我父所說的。」

lines.en: Think about this.
lines.zh: 想想看。

lines.en: If there's anybody that ever walked the earth that probably would have some pretty good ideas on his own, it would probably be Jesus.
lines.zh: 如果世上有誰可能靠自己就有很棒的想法，那大概就是耶穌了。

lines.en: But he was unwilling to come up with anything of his own.
lines.zh: 但祂不願意憑自己想出任何東西。

lines.en: The Gospel of John says, "He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory."
lines.zh: 約翰福音說：「憑著自己說的人，是求自己的榮耀。」

lines.en: He who speaks from himself, in other words, it all originates with me, seeks his own glory.
lines.zh: 憑著自己說的人，換句話說，也就是「這一切都源自我」的人，是在求自己的榮耀。

lines.en: In other words, us unwilling to tap into what the Father is saying is a subtle way to move into self-promotion.
lines.zh: 換句話說，我們若不願意去汲取天父所說的話，這其實是一種變相自我推銷的微妙方式。

lines.en: Acts chapter 3, another real quick one.
lines.zh: 使徒行傳第3章，另一個很快的經文。

lines.en: You guys all right?
lines.zh: 你們還好嗎？

lines.en: I hope so.
lines.zh: 希望如此。

lines.en: Acts chapter 3, this is a great prophetic passage.
lines.zh: 使徒行傳第3章，這是一段很棒的先知性經文。

lines.en: After the outpouring of the Spirit in chapter 2, verse 24 says,
lines.zh: 在第2章聖靈澆灌之後，第24節說：

lines.en: "Yes, all the prophets, from Samuel and those who follow, as many as have spoken, have also foretold these days."
lines.zh: 「從撒母耳以來的眾先知，凡說預言的，也都說到這些日子。」

lines.en: "You are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers,
lines.zh: 「你們是先知的子孫，也承受神與我們祖宗所立的約，

lines.en: saying to Abraham, 'And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.'"
lines.zh: 就是對亞伯拉罕說：地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。」

lines.en: Verse 25 again:
lines.zh: 再看一次第25節：

lines.en: "You are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers,
lines.zh: 「你們是先知的子孫，也承受神與我們祖宗所立的約，

lines.en: saying to Abraham, 'In your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.'"
lines.zh: 就是對亞伯拉罕說：地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。」

lines.en: This passage, Isaiah 59, was a passage given to the nation of Israel, but prophetically foretold the nation of the redeemed, which is the church.
lines.zh: 以賽亞書59章這段經文，是給以色列國的，但它先知性地預言了被救贖的國度，也就是教會。

lines.en: All right, but this one is clearly to the body of Christ.
lines.zh: 好的，但這一段清楚是給基督的身體。

lines.en: If you miss 59, this one for certain is to the body of Christ,
lines.zh: 如果你錯過了59章，這一段絕對是給基督身體的，

lines.en: in which he says, "You are the sons of the prophets, you are the daughters of the prophets."
lines.zh: 神在其中說：「你們是先知的兒子，你們是先知的女兒。」

lines.en: Why is that important?
lines.zh: 為什麼這很重要？

lines.en: Because of the covenant established that I will put my word in your mouth, in your descendants' mouth, and in your descendants' descendants' mouth.
lines.zh: 因為神立的約說，我會把我的話放在你的口中、你後裔的口中，以及你後裔之後裔的口中。

lines.en: The whole point is that a distinguishing feature of being in the tribe of God,
lines.zh: 重點在於，身為神部落的一份子，有一個顯著的特徵，

lines.en: who is carrying his heartbeat into the earth, is that he has put his Spirit upon us,
lines.zh: 就是將祂的心意帶到這世上，這特徵是祂已將祂的靈降臨在我們身上，

lines.en: manifested by every generation being able to carry and declare the word of the Lord.
lines.zh: 並彰顯於每一個世代都能夠承載，並宣告神的話語。

lines.en: Acts chapter 3 says, "You're the sons, you're the daughters of the prophets."
lines.zh: 使徒行傳第3章說：「你們是先知的兒子，你們是先知的女兒。」

lines.en: In other words, you have an inheritance.
lines.zh: 換句話說，你們有一份產業。

lines.en: It's important for us to know what inheritance is.
lines.zh: 我們必須知道這份產業是什麼。

lines.en: It's important for us to discover what God says about us,
lines.zh: 我們必須去發掘神對我們的宣告，

lines.en: because you're not going to write a check if you don't think you have the money in the bank.
lines.zh: 因為如果你不認為自己銀行裡有錢，你就不會去開支票。

lines.en: You're not going to withdraw from identity if you don't realize it exists.
lines.zh: 如果你不知道這身分的存在，你就不會從中支取。

lines.en: You're not going to live from something that is far above everything you could imagine, unless he reveals that's who you are.
lines.zh: 除非祂向你啟示這就是你的身分，否則你無法活出那遠超過你所求所想的生命。

lines.en: Once you realize who you are, your posture changes.
lines.zh: 一旦你明白你是誰，你的姿態就會改變。

lines.en: It's not arrogant, it's not self-centered, it's not even self-confidence.
lines.zh: 這不是傲慢，不是自我中心，甚至不是自信。

lines.en: It's a confidence in who God has pronounced you to be.
lines.zh: 這是一種對神所宣告你的身分的信心。

lines.en: And God says you are the sons, the daughters of the prophets.
lines.zh: 而神說你是先知的兒子，先知的女兒。

lines.en: Because of that, you're in line for an inheritance to carry the Spirit of God and the word of the Lord.
lines.zh: 正因如此，你具備繼承產業的資格，能承載神的靈與神的話語。

vocab.zh: 有可能獲得，有資格得到

lines.en: They are one and the same.
lines.zh: 它們是同一回事。

lines.en: Jesus is the Word made flesh.
lines.zh: 耶穌就是道成肉身。

lines.en: So the presence of God is the same as the voice of God.
lines.zh: 所以神的同在，就等同於神的聲音。

lines.en: Whenever you sense the presence, the voice is in the presence.
lines.zh: 每當你感覺到神的同在，神的聲音就在這同在裡。

lines.en: Whenever you hear the voice, the voice represents the face.
lines.zh: 每當你聽見神的聲音，這聲音就代表了祂的面容。

lessons.title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
lessons.titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
lessons.summaryZh: 懼怕人是因為失去了對神的注視，唯有敬畏神才是對付懼怕人的根本解藥。

lines.en: Now we'll leave that there.
lines.zh: 現在我們先停在這裡。

lines.en: All right, now let's get back to the verse I really want: Isaiah 51.
lines.zh: 好，現在我們回到我真正想講的經文：以賽亞書五十一章。

lines.en: Go to Isaiah 51, and we'll spend our remaining time in this kind of an abstract portion of Scripture.
lines.zh: 翻到以賽亞書五十一章，我們要把剩下的時間花在這段有點抽象的經文上。

lines.en: There's a little bit of difference again between... I have New King James and New American Standard,
lines.zh: 這裡又有一點翻譯上的差異……我有新欽定版和新美國標準版，

lines.en: and I've tried to study both to make sure that what I'm going to emphasize is accurate,
lines.zh: 我試著研讀這兩個版本，好確保我要強調的內容是準確的，

lines.en: and I do believe with all of my heart that it is.
lines.zh: 而且我全心相信它是準確的。

lines.en: All right, so I'm going to read out of the New King James, and then I'll make reference to a couple words.
lines.zh: 好，所以我要讀新欽定版，然後我會提到幾個詞。

lines.en: All right, Isaiah 51, verse 12:
lines.zh: 好，以賽亞書五十一章十二節：

lines.en: "I, even I, am He who comforts you. Who are you that you should be afraid?"
lines.zh: 「惟有我，是安慰你們的。你是誰，竟會害怕？」

lines.en: Perhaps you didn't catch that.
lines.zh: 或許你沒聽清楚。

lines.en: The Lord shows up and says, "I, even I, am the Lord who comforts you. Who do you think you are, being afraid?"
lines.zh: 主顯現並說：「惟有我，是安慰你的主。你以為你是誰，竟敢害怕？」

lines.en: Now, when I'm fearful, I want Papa God to come and cuddle me, massage my shoulders, soothe me,
lines.zh: 當我感到害怕時，我想要天父來擁抱我、按摩我的肩膀、安撫我，

lines.en: tell me it's going to be okay, "I'm going to go before you, I'm going to drive out the enemy forces, I'm going to protect you."
lines.zh: 告訴我一切都會沒事的：「我會走在你的前面，我會趕出敵軍，我會保護你。」

lines.en: But in this particular case, He chose not to do that.
lines.zh: 但在這個特定的情況下，祂選擇不這麼做。

lines.en: He said, "I, even I, am the one who comforts you. Who do you think you are, being afraid?"
lines.zh: 祂說：「惟有我，是安慰你的。你以為你是誰，竟敢害怕？」

lines.en: What right do you have to be afraid?
lines.zh: 你有什麼權利害怕？

lines.en: That may not be the way you want to hear it, but sometimes it's the way He delivers it.
lines.zh: 這也許不是你想聽到的方式，但有時候祂就是這樣表達的。

lines.en: This is perhaps an offensive thought, but I want you to think it through.
lines.zh: 這或許是個會冒犯人的想法，但我希望你仔細思考一下。

lines.en: If I become inward, if I become internal, all wrapped up and, "Oh no, this is going on, this is going on in my life, this is happening,"
lines.zh: 如果我變得退縮，變得內向，完全陷入自我中心，想著：「喔不，這件事發生了，我的生活中發生這個，正在發生那個，」

lines.en: I am going to end up in fear.
lines.zh: 我最終就會落入恐懼。

lines.en: Fear sometimes is the expression of selfishness, because it has lost a glimpse of the one who spread out the heavens.
lines.zh: 恐懼有時是自私的表現，因為它失去了對那位鋪張諸天之神的注視。

lines.en: He reveals Himself in this passage as the one who gives comfort.
lines.zh: 祂在這段經文中啟示自己是賜下安慰的那一位。

lines.en: In other words, I have to lose sight of Him to become fearful.
lines.zh: 換句話說，我必須失去對祂的注視才會變得恐懼。

lines.en: Here, let's read it again, verse 12:
lines.zh: 來，我們再讀一次，第十二節：

lines.en: "I, even I, am He who comforts you.
lines.zh: 「惟有我，是安慰你們的。

lines.en: Who are you that you should be afraid of a man who will die, of the son of man who will be made like grass?"
lines.zh: 你是誰，竟怕那必死的人？怕那要變如草的世人？」

lines.en: What is He dealing with here? He's confronting the fear of man.
lines.zh: 祂在這裡處理的是什麼？祂在對付對人的懼怕。

lines.en: I have people come to me, if I ever talk about this subject,
lines.zh: 如果我談到這個主題，就會有人來找我，

lines.en: people will line up and ask me to pray for them to be freed from the fear of man, which I do.
lines.zh: 人們會排隊請我為他們禱告，好讓他們從對人的懼怕中得釋放，我也會這麼做。

lines.en: But there is one basic cure for the fear of man: it's called the fear of God.
lines.zh: 但要治癒對人的懼怕，有一個根本的解藥：這就叫做敬畏神。

lines.en: You can't fear both.
lines.zh: 你不能兩者都怕。

lines.en: And forgive me for repeating, but people will say, "Well, there's no fear in love.
lines.zh: 原諒我再重複一次，但人們會說：「愛裡沒有懼怕。

lines.en: How can I love God and fear Him?"
lines.zh: 我怎麼能既愛神又敬畏祂呢？」

lines.en: You must not be married. That's all I've got to say about that.
lines.zh: 那你一定還沒結婚。關於這點我只能說這麼多。

lines.en: Whoever made up that one is obviously single.
lines.zh: 說出那句話的人顯然是單身。

lines.en: That's all I got to say, and all the married men said, "Amen."
lines.zh: 我言盡於此，然後所有已婚的男人都說：「阿們。」

lines.en: All right, verse 12, let's do it again.
lines.zh: 好，第十二節，我們再來一次。

lines.en: She told me to stand in that line, there it is.
lines.zh: 她叫我去排那個隊，就在那裡。

lines.en: I didn't even realize my jokes were prophetic this morning!
lines.zh: 我今早甚至沒意識到我的笑話是先知性的！

lines.en: I didn't even realize, but they are.
lines.zh: 我完全沒意識到，但它們確實是。

lines.en: See verse 12: "I, even I, am He who comforts you.
lines.zh: 看第十二節：「惟有我，是安慰你們的。

lines.en: Who are you that you should be afraid of a man who will die, of the son of man who will be made like grass?
lines.zh: 你是誰，竟怕那必死的人？怕那要變如草的世人？

lines.en: And you forget the Lord your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, who laid the foundations of the earth;
lines.zh: 卻忘記鋪張諸天、立定地基、創造你的耶和華？

lines.en: you have feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he has prepared to destroy.
lines.zh: 因欺壓者圖謀毀滅要發的暴怒，你每天不斷地害怕，

lines.en: And where is the fury of the oppressor?"
lines.zh: 其實那欺壓者的暴怒在哪裡呢？」

lines.en: Do you get a feel for what He's saying here?
lines.zh: 你能體會祂在這裡說什麼嗎？

lines.en: You're afraid of whoever—put someone in the blank—you're afraid of them.
lines.zh: 你害怕某個人——在空格裡填上某個人——你害怕他們。

lines.en: You had to exchange a fear of them... you replaced the fear of God with fearing a person.
lines.zh: 你必須把對他們的恐懼交換掉……你用對人的懼怕取代了對神的敬畏。

lines.en: Repent! I mean, that really is it. It's just repent, confess the sin of the fear of man.
lines.zh: 悔改！我的意思是，真的就是這樣。只要悔改，承認懼怕人這項罪。

lines.en: I'm not trying to do shame, guilt, you know, I'm not interested in that.
lines.zh: 我不是要讓你感到羞愧、內疚，你知道的，我對那沒興趣。

lines.en: But I am interested in people being free from the fear of man.
lines.zh: 但我非常有興趣讓人們從對人的懼怕中得釋放。

lines.en: And turning from the fear of man to the fear of God is just a short step.
lines.zh: 而從懼怕人轉向敬畏神，只是很短的一步。

lines.en: That's just a short step; you turn from one to the other.
lines.zh: 這只是短短的一步；你從其中一個轉向另一個。

lessons.title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
lessons.titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
lessons.summaryZh: 神將祂的話語放在我們口中，為了透過我們的宣告，在地上建立屬天的根基並呼喚出人的命定。

lines.en: And here's what He says following this.
lines.zh: 接著祂是這麼說的。

lines.en: This is actually where I wanted to go.
lines.zh: 這其實是我想要講的重點。

lines.en: So verse 15 says, "I am the Lord your God, who divided the sea, whose waves roared—the Lord of hosts is His name."
lines.zh: 所以第十五節說：「我是耶和華你的神，攪動大海，使海中的波浪匉訇，萬軍之耶和華是我的名。」

lines.en: Verse 16, "And I have put my words in your mouth, I have covered you with the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundation of the earth, and say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
lines.zh: 第十六節：「我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。」

lines.en: Listen carefully to this.
lines.zh: 仔細聽好。

lines.en: I've put my Spirit upon you, I've put my words in your mouth, I've put my Spirit upon you, I've covered you with my hand.
lines.zh: 我將我的靈降在你們身上，我將我的話放在你們口中，我將我的靈降在你們身上，我用我的手遮蔽你們。

lines.en: Yeah, this is interesting.
lines.zh: 是的，這很有意思。

lines.en: The Lord protects what He blesses.
lines.zh: 主會保護祂所賜福的。

lines.en: Do you remember this passage? It says, "And His favor surrounds me like a shield."
lines.zh: 你們記得這段經文嗎？上面說：「祂的恩惠如同盾牌四面護衛我。」

lines.en: That's because He protects what He blesses.
lines.zh: 那是因為祂保護祂所賜福的。

lines.en: He doesn't bless and then leave it to be devoured.
lines.zh: 祂不會在賜福之後，就任憑其被吞吃。

lines.en: Opposite—He blesses, and then He surrounds with protection.
lines.zh: 恰恰相反——祂賜福，然後祂以保護四面環繞。

lines.en: So here we have the Lord saying, "All right, I'm the one who put my word in your mouth."
lines.zh: 所以在這裡，我們看到主說：「好的，我是將我的話放在你口中的那一位。」

lines.en: And what did He do then?
lines.zh: 然後祂做了什麼？

lines.en: "I put my hand over you, I've covered you with the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, lay the foundation of the earth, and say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
lines.zh: 「我將我的手遮蔽你，我用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。」

lines.en: New American Standard says, "To establish the heavens."
lines.zh: 新美國標準譯本（NASB）說：「為要建立諸天。」

lines.en: The word 'establish' there, I looked it up in the New American Standard Study Bible, 'to establish the heavens' actually means to plant.
lines.zh: 「建立」這個詞，我去查了新美國標準研讀本聖經，「建立諸天」其實是栽種的意思。

lines.en: So I want you to think with me.
lines.zh: 所以我要你們跟我一起思考。

lines.en: "I put my words in your mouth, I've covered you with the shadow of my hand, because I want, through you, to plant the heavens and build solid foundations on the earth."
lines.zh: 「我將我的話放在你們口中，我用我的手影遮蔽你們，因為我想要透過你們去栽定諸天，並在全地建立堅固的地基。」

lines.en: This is an Old Testament warm-up for, "Yes, on earth as it is in heaven."
lines.zh: 這是舊約時代的暖身，沒錯，就是為了「行在地上，如同行在天上」。

lines.en: He's revealing a process.
lines.zh: 祂正在啟示一個過程。

lines.en: He's revealing the tool that He uses to release the reality of one world to rest upon the reality of another.
lines.zh: 祂正在啟示祂用來釋放一個世界的真實、使其降臨在另一個世界的真實之上的工具。

lines.en: He says, "I'm going to build strong foundations here, and then I'm going to plant that world where there's strong foundations."
lines.zh: 祂說：「我要在這裡建立堅固的地基，然後我要將那個世界栽種在有堅固地基的地方。」

lines.en: How is it done?
lines.zh: 這是怎麼成就的呢？

lines.en: Through decree.
lines.zh: 透過宣告。

lines.en: "I have put my words in your mouth, I've covered you with the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"
lines.zh: 「我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽定諸天，立定地基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。」

lines.en: Moses interceded, "Oh, that all God's people were prophets."
lines.zh: 摩西曾代禱：「惟願耶和華的百姓都是先知。」

lines.en: Jesus talked about the prophets and the spiritual fathers of the Old Testament, they longed to see what we see.
lines.zh: 耶穌談到舊約的先知和屬靈先賢時說，他們渴望看見我們所看見的。

lines.en: I'd like to suggest to you that out of the ache of his heart, Moses was prophesying about the day that you and I live in, where all the people of God would be carrying prophetic anointing.
lines.zh: 我想告訴你們，摩西出於他心中的迫切渴望，正預言著你我如今所生活的這個日子，在這樣的日子裡，神所有的子民都將帶著先知性的恩膏。

lines.en: That is not, number one, self-serving.
lines.zh: 這恩膏第一不是為了自私自利。

lines.en: Number two, it is not to expose and tear down in this hour; it is to call out destiny.
lines.zh: 第二，在這個時刻，它不是為了揭發和拆毀；它是為了呼喚出命定。

lines.en: We've watched this now for years, where somebody will be caught up in a lie, maybe they believed about their whole life.
lines.zh: 這幾年來我們一直看到這樣的情況：有人深陷在一個謊言中，也許是他們一輩子都信以為真的謊言。

lines.en: In fact, we see this happen often now to people who don't even know the Lord.
lines.zh: 事實上，我們現在常看到這種情況發生在甚至還不認識主的人身上。

lines.en: They don't even know the Lord, and one of you will come along and just call out the gold in their life, and it completely changes them.
lines.zh: 他們甚至還不認識主，而你們當中的某個人走過來，直接點出他們生命中的黃金，這就徹底改變了他們。

lines.en: It changes their entire life.
lines.zh: 這改變了他們的一生。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 為什麼？

lines.en: Because they've got this lie that they bought into for a lifetime, and somebody comes with one word of truth, and it completely changes their identity.
lines.zh: 因為他們一直以來都買單了這個跟隨他們一輩子的謊言，然後有人帶著一句真理的話語來到，這就徹底改變了他們的身份認同。

lines.en: Where they start living from a different place.
lines.zh: 讓他們開始從一個截然不同的立足點來生活。

lines.en: They move into—they repent, they turn from this, embracing what God has said about them.
lines.zh: 他們進入——他們悔改，他們轉離這一切，去擁抱神對他們的宣告。

lines.en: Every person in this room, the Lord has declared strong things, powerful things, positive things, corrective things, adjusting words.
lines.zh: 在這房間裡的每一個人，主都曾對你們宣告過剛強的話、大能的話、正面的話、糾正的話、調整的話。

lines.en: All these things have been declared over every one of us.
lines.zh: 所有這些話都已經宣告在我們每個人身上。

lines.en: And when we hear them, when we embrace them, they empower us to make changes that are impossible otherwise.
lines.zh: 當我們聽見這些話，當我們擁抱這些話，它們就賦予我們能力，去做出原本不可能做出的改變。

lines.en: And the Lord is inviting us into being a people that hear the voice of the Lord.
lines.zh: 而主正在邀請我們，成為一群能聽見主聲音的子民。

lines.en: If there's anything that is mocked in the earth right now, it is that you could actually hear God's voice.
lines.zh: 如果說現在世上有什麼事是備受嘲笑的，那就是你竟然真的能聽見神的聲音。

lines.en: It's mocked, it's mocked openly.
lines.zh: 這被人嘲弄，被人公開地嘲弄。

lines.en: And I believe simply leaning in, every one of us has had the experience where, oh, we just randomly called a friend, and come to find out it was the exact moment of crisis, and they needed help, and we didn't know.
lines.zh: 而我相信，只要單純地靠近祂，我們每個人都曾有過這樣的經歷：我們隨意打電話給一個朋友，結果發現那正是他們面臨危機的時刻，他們需要幫助，而我們事先並不知情。

lines.en: It wasn't this thundering voice.
lines.zh: 那不是什麼如雷貫耳的聲音。

lines.en: It wasn't, "Bill, call this number," you know, it wasn't that.
lines.zh: 那不是：「比爾，打這支電話」，你們懂嗎，不是那樣的。

lines.en: It wasn't a number appears on the wall and you punch that number out and you talk to... it's not that.
lines.zh: 也不是牆上浮現出一串號碼，然後你按下號碼跟對方說話……不是那樣的。

lines.en: It's the subtle leaning into a lifestyle of the presence of God, the Spirit of God.
lines.zh: 那是種微妙的靠近，進入一種活在神同在、聖靈同在中的生活方式。

lines.en: And you find yourself day after day after day bringing the word of the Lord, till it becomes a lifestyle where you think His thoughts, you declare His words.
lines.zh: 然後你會發現自己日復一日地帶下主的話語，直到這成為一種生活方式，你會思想祂的想法，宣告祂的話語。

lines.en: And it's not the strain and the effort of trying to hear from God.
lines.zh: 那不需要為了努力聽見神的聲音而感到緊繃和費力。

lines.en: I don't hear well when I try.
lines.zh: 當我刻意去試的時候，我反而聽得不清楚。

lines.en: I don't hear good at all when I try.
lines.zh: 當我刻意去試的時候，我根本聽不好。

lessons.title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
lessons.titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
lessons.summaryZh: 藉由降服來聆聽神，用話語釋放恩典，並為有需要的人禱告服事。
lessons.ref: 以賽亞書 51:16, 約伯記 36:32, 以弗所書 4:29

lines.en: You know what I do sometimes in healing meetings when I'm in other places?
lines.zh: 你知道有時候我在其他地方的醫治聚會中會怎麼做嗎？

lines.en: Sometimes we're in a healing meeting, during worship, I will sneak around and find people that need a miracle and pray for them then.
lines.zh: 有時候我們在醫治聚會中，在敬拜時，我會溜達尋找需要神蹟的人，然後為他們禱告。

lines.en: Because I know that if we wait till the official time to be healed, they'll try too hard.
lines.zh: 因為我知道，如果我們等到正式的醫治時間，他們會太過努力。

lines.en: And faith does not become evident through effort.
lines.zh: 而信心並不是透過努力來彰顯的。

lines.en: Hearing from God does not come through effort; it comes through surrender.
lines.zh: 聆聽神的聲音不是透過努力；它是透過降服。

lines.en: Faith is the product of yieldedness; it's not the product of, 'I'm determined to live for the glory of God.'
lines.zh: 信心是順服的產物；它不是『我下定決心要為神的榮耀而活』的產物。

lines.en: Yeah, sweat all you want. As soon as you get exhausted, you'll hear from God.
lines.zh: 是啊，你想怎麼流汗努力都可以。一旦你筋疲力盡，你就會聽見神的聲音。

lines.en: As soon as you finally say, 'I'm done,' then He speaks.
lines.zh: 一旦你終於說：『我不行了』，祂就會說話。

lines.en: Why? Because if He speaks when you are striving with effort, He will only reaffirm flesh and carnality, and not the genuineness of who you are in Christ.
lines.zh: 為什麼？因為如果祂在你努力掙扎時說話，祂只會認可肉體和血氣，而不是你在基督裡真實的身分。

lines.en: So let me read this verse again.
lines.zh: 所以讓我再讀一次這節經文。

lines.en: It says, 'I have put My words in your mouth; I have covered you with the shadow of My hand, that I may plant the heavens, lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, "You are My people."'
lines.zh: 經上說：『我將我的話傳給你，用我的手影遮蔽你，為要栽上眾星，立定地的根基，又對錫安說：你是我的百姓。』

lines.en: I didn't prepare ahead of time to find this verse, and I apologize for that.
lines.zh: 我沒有事先準備好要找這節經文，對此我感到抱歉。

lines.en: But there's a great verse in Job where Job talks about him declaring a word, and it puts a mark on someone for God to strike.
lines.zh: 但在約伯記裡有一節很棒的經文，約伯提到宣告一句話，它就在某人身上做了一個記號，讓神來擊中。

lines.en: It's like he throws out the word, and the Lord is attracted to that word.
lines.zh: 這就像他把話語拋出去，而主就被那話語吸引。

lines.en: It's actually the concept that we find in Ephesians 4, where he says, 'Let no unwholesome word proceed from your mouth.'
lines.zh: 這實際上就是我們在以弗所書第四章看到的觀念，那裡說：『污穢的言語一句不可出口。』

lines.en: Which is a great standard for all prophetic people.
lines.zh: 這對所有先知性的人來說是一個很棒的標準。

lines.en: 'Let no unwholesome word proceed from your mouth, but only such a word as is good for edification according to the need of the moment, so that it will give grace to those who hear.'
lines.zh: 『污穢的言語一句不可出口，只要隨事說造就人的好話，好將恩典賜給聽見的人。』

lines.en: What is grace? It is divine favor.
lines.zh: 什麼是恩典？恩典是神聖的恩寵。

lines.en: Think with me: only speak edifying words that it might give grace.
lines.zh: 跟我一起想：只說造就人的話，好讓它能賜下恩典。

lines.en: What is grace? Divine favor.
lines.zh: 恩典是什麼？是神聖的恩寵。

lines.en: You choose who to encourage, and your word of encouragement is something that God approves of.
lines.zh: 你選擇要鼓勵誰，而你鼓勵的話語是神所認可的。

lines.en: And He pours favor into the person you've chosen to encourage.
lines.zh: 然後祂將恩寵傾注在你選擇鼓勵的那個人身上。

lines.en: Grace. It's the same concept.
lines.zh: 恩典。這是一樣的概念。

lines.en: You put the word there.
lines.zh: 你把話語放在那裡。

lines.en: You come to somebody you do business with, a neighbor, you just go over, you just encourage them.
lines.zh: 你走到一個跟你做生意的人、一個鄰居面前，你就是走過去，你就是鼓勵他們。

lines.en: You just give them an encouraging word.
lines.zh: 你就是給他們一句鼓勵的話。

lines.en: You just tell them, 'This is what I see God doing in your life. It's a beautiful thing.'
lines.zh: 你就是告訴他們：『這是我看見神在你生命中正在做的事。這是一件美好的事。』

lines.en: Or, 'I just want to encourage you; you're so gifted in this area.'
lines.zh: 或者，『我只是想鼓勵你；你在這方面非常有恩賜。』

lines.en: What are you doing? You're just planting a word.
lines.zh: 你在做什麼？你只不過是在栽種一句話。

lines.en: And God is going to put favor right there, put grace right there, pour the grace in right there.
lines.zh: 而神就要把恩寵放在那裡，把恩典放在那裡，將恩典傾注在那裡。

lines.en: Why? 'Because one of My own distributed a word of encouragement there; I've got to back it up.'
lines.zh: 為什麼？『因為我自己的孩子在那裡散播了一句鼓勵的話；我必須要支持它。』

lines.en: Why don't you stand?
lines.zh: 你們何不站起來呢？

lines.en: You know how we started the prophetic in Weaverville years ago?
lines.zh: 你們知道多年前我們在威弗維爾（Weaverville）是如何開始先知性服事的嗎？

lines.en: There was zero prophetic, zero.
lines.zh: 那裡當時完全沒有先知性，歸零。

lines.en: There wasn't a prophetic mouse, there wasn't a prophetic flea; it was zero when we moved there.
lines.zh: 那裡沒有一隻先知性的老鼠，也沒有一隻先知性的跳蚤；當我們搬去的時候，那是零。

lines.en: So I'd get men to sit around a table, and I'd turn to the one on my right.
lines.zh: 所以我會找些弟兄圍坐在桌旁，然後轉向我右邊的那位。

lines.en: I'd say, 'If Jesus were to walk in the room right now, what do you think He'd say?'
lines.zh: 我會說：『如果耶穌現在走進這個房間，你覺得祂會說什麼？』

lines.en: And they'd go, 'I think He'd say...'
lines.zh: 他們就會說：『我覺得祂會說……』

lines.en: I'd go to the next one, go all the way around the room.
lines.zh: 我會繼續問下一個，就這樣繞著房間問一圈。

lines.en: And after we got all the way around the room, I'd say, 'Do you realize that you all just prophesied?'
lines.zh: 當我們繞完房間一圈後，我會說：『你們知道你們剛剛都發預言了嗎？』

lines.en: And they'd go, 'Huh, is it that easy?'
lines.zh: 然後他們會說：『咦，有這麼簡單嗎？』

lines.en: See, when you strive is when you miss it.
lines.zh: 看吧，當你努力掙扎時，你就會錯失它。

lines.en: It's when you're relaxing in who you are, abiding in His presence, abiding in His voice.
lines.zh: 而是當你在自己的身分中放鬆，常在祂的同在裡，常在祂的聲音中時。

lines.en: It becomes very natural to speak words that are life-giving.
lines.zh: 說出賜生命的話語就會變得很自然。

lines.en: Put your hands in front of you.
lines.zh: 把你們的手舉在身前。

lines.en: Let me pray for this prophetic anointing to be released.
lines.zh: 讓我為釋放這先知性的恩膏來禱告。

lines.en: Lord, I do pray for that.
lines.zh: 主啊，我為此禱告。

lines.en: I pray that You would increase the mantle of the prophetic.
lines.zh: 我祈求祢增加先知性的外袍。

lines.en: God, help us to keep it pure, to keep it real, but to serve our city well. Thank you, amen.
lines.zh: 神啊，幫助我們保持它的純潔，保持真實，並能好好服事我們的城市。謝謝祢，阿們。

lines.en: Okay, if you'd hold your places for just a moment.
lines.zh: 好的，請大家稍微留在原位一下。

lines.en: I know in a crowd this size, we always have people who don't know the Lord.
lines.zh: 我知道在這麼多人的群眾中，我們總會有人還不認識主。

lines.en: And if there's anyone here today that would just say, 'Bill, I don't want to leave this place until I know that I am right with God.'
lines.zh: 如果今天這裡有任何人願意說：『比爾，我不想離開這個地方，直到我知道我與神的關係是對的。』

lines.en: 'Until I know that I've been forgiven of sin and brought into His personal family.'
lines.zh: 『直到我知道我的罪已得赦免，並被帶入祂親自建立的家中。』

lines.en: If you would be willing to say that, I want you just to put your hand up where you are, because we're just going to pray.
lines.zh: 如果你願意這麼說，我希望你就在原位舉起手，因為我們就是要來禱告。

lines.en: Just put your hand right here, we have one.
lines.zh: 把你的手舉起來——就在這裡，我們看到一位。

lines.en: Anybody else? Just put your hand up real quick. Another one back here.
lines.zh: 還有其他人嗎？趕快舉起你的手。後面還有一位。

lines.en: Just say, 'Bill, I don't want to leave till I know I'm right with God.'
lines.zh: 只要說：『比爾，我不想離開，直到我知道我與神的關係是對的。』

lines.en: I know we have two overflow rooms as well.
lines.zh: 我知道我們還有兩個副堂。

lines.en: For those in the overflow rooms, do the same thing.
lines.zh: 在副堂裡的人，也請做同樣的事。

lines.en: In fact, this is what I want to say: the two that put your hands up, if you just come right down over here.
lines.zh: 事實上，這是我想要說的：那兩位舉手的，請你們直接走到這裡來。

lines.en: And if there's any others, come quickly over here.
lines.zh: 如果有其他人，也請趕快走到這裡來。

lines.en: We have some people that we know and love and trust that are going to pray for you.
lines.zh: 我們有一些我們認識、所愛且信任的人，他們會為你們禱告。

lines.en: I need our Freedom Team down here.
lines.zh: 我需要我們的自由事工團隊到前面來。

lines.en: And if you're in one of the other two overflow rooms, please just make your way from there to here right now.
lines.zh: 如果你在另外兩個副堂裡，請現在就從那裡走到這裡來。

lines.en: And we've got a group of people that are going to pray for you.
lines.zh: 我們有一群人會為你們禱告。

lines.en: All right, this is the most important thing that's happened all day, right here.
lines.zh: 好，今天一整天發生最重要的事情，就在這裡。

lines.en: This is the most time-sensitive issue of the day, right here.
lines.zh: 這是今天最具有時效性（急迫）的事情，就在這裡。

lines.en: So we're going to pray that the Lord would touch them so deeply and so profoundly.
lines.zh: 所以我們要禱告主會如此深刻且深遠地觸摸他們。

lines.en: I need some more of our Freedom Team down here.
lines.zh: 我需要更多自由事工團隊的人到前面來。

lines.en: Also, I want to have our ministry team come to the front.
lines.zh: 同時，我要請我們的服事團隊到前面來。

lines.en: If everyone else could hold your place for just a moment, this does help us out.
lines.zh: 如果其他人能稍微留在原位一下，這對我們很有幫助。

lines.en: We want to open it up for people to receive the miracle in your body, the miracle in your life.
lines.zh: 我們想開放讓大家領受你身體上的神蹟、你生命中的神蹟。

lines.en: It's just become normal for Jesus to touch and heal people.
lines.zh: 耶穌觸摸並醫治人，這已經成為常態了。

lines.en: So we encourage you, come be a part of that.
lines.zh: 所以我們鼓勵你，來成為這其中的一份子。

lines.en: And B, why don't you explain what to do and how to do it? All right.
lines.zh: 而Ｂ，你來解釋一下該做什麼以及如何做吧？好的。

lessons.title: The Danger of Being Easily Offended
lessons.summaryZh: 魔鬼常將冒犯與苦毒偽裝成屬靈的分辨力，藉此蒙蔽我們的理智。

lines.en: I don't want the poison of offense to cloud my vision, my seeing.
lines.zh: 我不希望冒犯的毒根蒙蔽我的異象、我的眼光。

lines.en: I don't want it to affect my thinking, my reasoning, because it does.
lines.zh: 我不希望它影響我的思考和理智，因為它確實會。

lines.en: That's the target.
lines.zh: 那正是它的目標。

lines.en: The target is to get offense, to get bitterness, envy, any of these things,
lines.zh: 它的目標是要讓你產生冒犯、苦毒、嫉妒或任何這類東西，

lines.en: to get it somewhere influencing the reasoning,
lines.zh: 讓它在某處影響你的理智，

lines.en: so that I'm not able to demonstrate the heart of God on planet earth in the measure He desires.
lines.zh: 以至於我無法按照神所渴望的程度，在地球上彰顯祂的心意。

lines.en: Let's go to James chapter three.
lines.zh: 我們來看《雅各書》第三章。

lines.en: What we're going to see here is we recognize that the devil doesn't come to us in a red rubber suit with horns and a pitchfork.
lines.zh: 我們在這裡將會看到，我們會認清魔鬼不會穿著紅色橡膠裝、頭上長角、拿著乾草叉來到我們面前。

lines.en: He doesn't make himself known as the devil.
lines.zh: 他不會表明自己就是魔鬼。

lines.en: He makes himself known as something we would value.
lines.zh: 他會把自己偽裝成我們所看重的東西。

lines.en: He actually has to parade his thoughts as virtuous thoughts for us to embrace them.
lines.zh: 實際上，他必須把他的思想標榜為美善的思想，好讓我們去接受。

lines.en: That was a good point, Bill, that was a really good point.
lines.zh: 講得好，比爾，這點講得真好。

lines.en: He has to actually parade what the Bible calls him, the angel of light.
lines.zh: 實際上他必須這樣標榜自己——就像聖經稱他為「光明的天使」。

lines.en: So he has to parade himself in a way where we think or feel that we are discerning or moving in some sort of a virtue.
lines.zh: 所以他必須以一種方式來標榜自己，讓我們認為或感覺自己很有分辨力，或者正行在某種美德中。

lines.en: The problem is that way of life, that way of thinking does not carry peace with it.
lines.zh: 問題是，那種生活方式、那種思維模式並沒有帶來平安。

lines.en: It does not bear the fruit of peace or righteousness.
lines.zh: 它結不出平安或公義的果子。

lines.en: So let's go into this passage out of James chapter 3.
lines.zh: 所以讓我們來看這段出自《雅各書》第三章的經文。

lines.en: Verse 13:
lines.zh: 第13節：

lines.en: 'Who is wise and understanding among you?
lines.zh: 「你們中間誰是有智慧有見識的呢？

lines.en: Let him show by good conduct that his works are done in the meekness of wisdom.'
lines.zh: 他就當在智慧的溫柔上顯出他的善行來。」

lines.en: I love that phrase, 'meekness of wisdom,' my goodness.
lines.zh: 我好喜歡「智慧的溫柔」這個詞，天哪。

lines.en: Don't pursue wisdom without meekness, or don't think you have it unless there's meekness.
lines.zh: 不要追求沒有溫柔的智慧，除非有溫柔，否則別以為你擁有智慧。

lines.en: Meekness is not weakness.
lines.zh: 溫柔不是軟弱。

lines.en: Meekness isn't weakness; meekness is yielded strength.
lines.zh: 溫柔不是軟弱；溫柔是降服的力量。

lines.en: The biblical illustration of meekness is the wild horse that becomes trained.
lines.zh: 聖經中關於溫柔的比喻，就像一匹被馴服的野馬。

lines.en: It's still as strong to jump the biggest fence,
lines.zh: 牠依然強壯到能跳過最高的柵欄，

lines.en: it just only does it at the commander's word.
lines.zh: 只是牠只在主人的口令下才會這麼做。

lines.en: Verse 14:
lines.zh: 第14節：

lines.en: 'If you have bitter envy, self-seeking in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth.'
lines.zh: 「你們心裡若懷著苦毒的嫉妒和分爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。」

lines.en: 'This wisdom does not descend from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.'
lines.zh: 「這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。」

lines.en: 'For where envy and self-seeking exist, confusion and every evil thing are there.'
lines.zh: 「在何處有嫉妒、分爭，就在何處有擾亂和各樣的壞事。」

lines.en: 'But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, willing to yield,'—interesting—
lines.zh: 「惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，」——很有意思——

lines.en: 'full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy.'
lines.zh: 「滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。」

lines.en: 'Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.'
lines.zh: 「並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。」

lines.en: Go back to verse 14 and 15, and then I want to talk to you for a bit.
lines.zh: 回到第14和15節，然後我想跟你們談一下。

lines.en: 'If you have bitter envy, self-seeking in your heart, do not boast and lie against the truth.'
lines.zh: 「你們心裡若懷著苦毒的嫉妒和分爭，就不可自誇，也不可說謊話抵擋真道。」

lines.en: Look at this phrase:
lines.zh: 注意這句話：

lines.en: 'This wisdom does not descend from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.'
lines.zh: 「這樣的智慧不是從上頭來的，乃是屬地的，屬情慾的，屬鬼魔的。」

lines.en: What's the key here?
lines.zh: 這裡的關鍵是什麼？

lines.en: Bitterness, offense, jealousy, envy—all of these things carry with it the appearance of wisdom.
lines.zh: 苦毒、冒犯、忌妒、嫉妒——所有這些東西都帶著智慧的外表。

lines.en: That's why a Christian would embrace it;
lines.zh: 這就是為什麼基督徒會接受它；

lines.en: it makes us feel discerning.
lines.zh: 它讓我們覺得自己很有分辨力。

lessons.title: The Danger of Being Easily Offended
lessons.summaryZh: 講員分享自己如何求神顯明心中隱藏的冒犯，並選擇主動放棄被冒犯的權利。

lines.en: It just doesn't bear the fruit of peace, of righteous living.
lines.zh: 這就是結不出平安與公義生活的果子。

lines.en: If I were to call out what I think is the number one enemy,
lines.zh: 如果我要點出我認為的頭號大敵，

lines.en: that I've seen at work in the body of Christ in the last two years,
lines.zh: 就是過去兩年來，我看到在基督的身體裡運作的，

lines.en: it would be offense.
lines.zh: 那就是被冒犯。

lines.en: And it's connected to this right here.
lines.zh: 這與我們剛才談到的有關。

lines.en: It appears as wisdom. It comes with reason.
lines.zh: 它以智慧的姿態出現，並伴隨著看似合理的理由。

lines.en: Have you ever met a bitter person that didn't have a good reason?
lines.zh: 你見過有哪個苦毒的人，是沒有充分理由的嗎？

lines.en: It's their reasoning. Offense is that way.
lines.zh: 這就是他們的理智。被冒犯就是這樣。

lines.en: I've been on a little journey myself.
lines.zh: 我自己最近經歷了一段小小的旅程。

lines.en: I've mentioned it before and a few months ago,
lines.zh: 我之前和幾個月前都曾提過，

lines.en: but over the last, I would say maybe six months, I've been asking the Lord,
lines.zh: 但在過去大約六個月裡，我一直求問神：

lines.en: "Man, I don't want any trace of offense in my heart about anything ever."
lines.zh: 「主啊，我永遠不希望心裡有任何一點被冒犯的痕跡，無論是對任何事。」

lines.en: I don't want to live under that influence.
lines.zh: 我不想要活在那樣的影響之下。

lines.en: And to be honest with you, I'm one of the most forgiving people I know.
lines.zh: 老實說，我是我認識的人中最願意饒恕的。

lines.en: And that's an arrogant thing to say, but I really don't care at this point.
lines.zh: 這麼說有點傲慢，但在此刻我真的不在乎了。

lines.en: I honestly am so quick to forgive.
lines.zh: 我真的非常快就能夠饒恕。

lines.en: And yet I've asked the Lord, "Show me any place where there's offense."
lines.zh: 然而我還是求神：「向我顯明任何有冒犯的地方。」

lines.en: Because you don't have to be bitter to live under the influence of offense.
lines.zh: 因為你不需要變得苦毒，也可能活在被冒犯的影響之下。

lines.en: I've dealt with the unforgiveness stuff, as much as, to my knowledge, I have dealt with.
lines.zh: 我已經對付了不饒恕的問題，就我所知，我已經盡力處理了。

lines.en: But you can still unknowingly live under the influence of an offense and still not be bitter.
lines.zh: 但你仍然可能在不知不覺中活在被冒犯的影響下，卻沒有變得苦毒。

lines.en: Guard your heart. But you live under the pain of that when you don't need to.
lines.zh: 要保守你的心。因為當你本不需要承受時，卻活在那種痛苦中。

lines.en: So I've been asking the Lord to just show me this stuff for the last six months.
lines.zh: 所以在過去這六個月裡，我一直求神向我顯明這些事。

lines.en: At the most random times, I'll be just driving down the road,
lines.zh: 在最隨機的時刻，我可能只是開車在路上，

lines.en: and I will remember something somebody said to me in high school.
lines.zh: 就會想起高中時某人對我說過的話。

lines.en: "Really? Do we have to go that far back?" you know.
lines.zh: 「真的嗎？有必要追溯到那麼久以前嗎？」你知道的。

lines.en: Or something that was done in grade school, or something was done last year.
lines.zh: 或者是小學時發生的事，又或者是去年發生的事。

lines.en: I mean, just all kinds of very random things.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，就是各種非常隨機的事情。

lines.en: The conversation at the Chicago airport with a young man who had certain opinions and conclusions about me.
lines.zh: 在芝加哥機場與一位年輕人的對話，他對我有一些個人的看法和結論。

lines.en: So that comes to mind.
lines.zh: 這件事浮現在腦海。

lines.en: I can see his face, I can take you where we were in the airport.
lines.zh: 我能看見他的臉，我甚至能帶你去我們當時在機場的那個位置。

lines.en: And I say, "I give up my right to be offended. I give up my right."
lines.zh: 然後我說：「我放棄被冒犯的權利。我放棄我的權利。」

lines.en: The lady who flips me off in the car, I pull over to have a conversation with her.
lines.zh: 在車上對我比中指的那個女士，我把車停在路邊和她談話。

lines.en: I give up my right to be offended.
lines.zh: 我放棄被冒犯的權利。

lines.en: The money that was stolen, the dishonesty in this deal, I give up my right to be offended.
lines.zh: 被偷走的錢，在這筆交易中的不誠實，我放棄被冒犯的權利。

lines.en: And what happens is you just have this stuff just dial up.
lines.zh: 結果就是，你會讓這些事情湧上心頭。

lines.en: Now I need you to understand, because there could be a horrible misunderstanding.
lines.zh: 現在我需要你們明白，因為這可能會產生一個可怕的誤會。

lines.en: I don't recognize anything yet He's brought up where I have harbored resentment or bitterness.
lines.zh: 我還沒有發現祂所提出來的任何一件事，是我一直懷怨或苦毒的。

lines.en: But there's something powerful that's done in my heart.
lines.zh: 但我的心裡經歷了一件大有能力的事。

lines.en: I don't know how else to say that.
lines.zh: 我不知道還能怎麼表達。

lines.en: Something powerful is down in my heart when I look at that.
lines.zh: 當我檢視那件事時，我的內心深處經歷了大能。

lines.en: The guy who met me at the airport here in Redding,
lines.zh: 在雷丁這裡的機場遇見我的那個人，

lines.en: and just read me the riot act on my eternal destination.
lines.zh: 就因為我永恆的歸宿而對我大發雷霆。

lessons.title: The Danger of Being Easily Offended
lessons.summaryZh: 拒絕冒犯能保護我們的心思；悔改是重新對齊神看事情的眼光，使我們成為活祭。

lines.en: I can still see his face.
lines.zh: 我依然能看見他的臉。

lines.en: "I give up my right to be offended."
lines.zh: 「我放棄被冒犯的權利。」

lines.en: Honestly, I've tried to take it a step farther.
lines.zh: 老實說，我試著更進一步。

lines.en: In cases like this, I pray for great mercy, great grace.
lines.zh: 在這種情況下，我祈求極大的憐憫和極大的恩典。

lines.en: But the point is, I don't want the poison of offense to cloud my vision.
lines.zh: 但重點是，我不希望冒犯的毒根蒙蔽我的眼光。

lines.en: I don't want it to affect my thinking, my reasoning, because it does.
lines.zh: 我不希望它影響我的思考和理智，因為它確實會。

lines.en: That's the target.
lines.zh: 那就是（仇敵的）目標。

lines.en: The target is to get offense, to get bitterness, envy, any of these things, to get it somewhere influencing the reasoning.
lines.zh: 它的目標是要讓冒犯、苦毒、嫉妒或任何這些東西，進入某處去影響我們的理智。

lines.en: So that I'm not able to demonstrate the heart of God on planet Earth in the measure He desires.
lines.zh: 好讓我無法在地球上，按著神所渴望的程度，來彰顯祂的心意。

lines.en: So I want you to look with me at Romans 12, and we'll take this for the remaining part of the morning.
lines.zh: 所以我想請你們和我一起看羅馬書 12 章，我們早上剩下的時間就來講這段。

lines.en: You guys still alive?
lines.zh: 你們都還醒著嗎？

lines.en: I don't know what I'd do if you said no, but I do prefer people surviving the meeting.
lines.zh: 我不知道如果你們說沒有我該怎麼辦，但我確實希望大家能撐過這場聚會。

lines.en: Verse 1 of chapter 12, Romans 12: "I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service."
lines.zh: 羅馬書 12 章第 1 節：「所以弟兄們，我以神的慈悲勸你們，將身體獻上，當作活祭，是聖潔的，是神所喜悅的；你們如此事奉乃是理所當然的。」

lines.en: I think one of the translations, maybe New American, says, "reasonable service of worship."
lines.zh: 我想有一個譯本，也許是新美國標準譯本，說的是「理所當然的敬拜事奉」。

lines.en: Present your bodies a living sacrifice, your reasonable service.
lines.zh: 將身體獻上，當作活祭，你們理所當然的事奉。

lines.en: Becoming a living offering is the intellectual thing to do.
lines.zh: 成為一個活祭是明智之舉。

lines.en: Have you discovered yet that God thinks different than you?
lines.zh: 你發現了嗎？神思考的方式和你不同。

lines.en: Guess who's not going to change?
lines.zh: 猜猜看誰不會改變？

lines.en: What repentance does is it re-engages with the way He thinks.
lines.zh: 悔改的作用，就是重新接上祂思考的方式。

lines.en: That's what repentance is.
lines.zh: 這就是悔改。

lines.en: Repentance is reconnecting with the perception of God regarding a matter.
lines.zh: 悔改是重新連結神對某件事的看法。

lines.en: His perception is different.
lines.zh: 祂的看法是不同的。

lines.en: Most of our lives are spent in the middle of challenges, difficulties, problems, victories, whatever it might be.
lines.zh: 我們生命中大部分的時間都花在面對挑戰、困難、問題或勝利，不管那是什麼。

lines.en: And in the middle of these issues, we are crying out to God for Him to come and help, and to fix the situation.
lines.zh: 在這些問題當中，我們呼求神來幫助，並解決這景況。

lines.en: But Jesus modeled a different way of living.
lines.zh: 但耶穌示範了另一種不同的生活方式。

lines.en: I hope that we can come into this instruction and experience more thoroughly in the next couple of years.
lines.zh: 我希望在接下來的幾年裡，我們能更透徹地進入這項教導和經歷中。

lines.en: Yeah, I'm so glad that you watched this video.
lines.zh: 是的，我很高興你們看了這支影片。

lines.en: I do pray that it's a great strength and encouragement to you.
lines.zh: 我真誠地祈求這對你們是極大的力量和鼓勵。

lines.en: And I've got a verse that really is my cry for all of us, and it's Psalms 20, it's verse 4:
lines.zh: 我有一節經文，真的是我為我們大家的呼求，那就是詩篇 20 篇，第 4 節：

lines.en: "May He grant you your heart's desire and fulfill all your plans."
lines.zh: 「將你心所願的賜給你，成就你的一切籌算。」

lines.en: That's my prayer.
lines.zh: 那是我的禱告。

lines.en: That's my prayer, that this would be a season of rich fulfillment.
lines.zh: 那是我的禱告，願這是一個經歷豐富成就的季節。

lines.en: Thanks for joining us.
lines.zh: 感謝你們的參與。
